name: Claude Code Dev Container
// .NET note: The dotnet SDK here is for tooling only: csharp-ls (installed via install-enabled-lsps when enabled), scripts, and analyzers.
A full build of the Revit add-in ('dotnet build -c "Debug 2024"') requires Windows + the Revit SDK DLLs and cannot run in this Linux container.
// LSP installation strategy: We do NOT hardcode which LSP servers to install. Instead, /setup-lsp (run by the project lead) writes the chosen LSP plugins into .claude/settings.json's enabledPlugins, that file gets committed, and this container reads that committed list to install only what's actually needed.
This keeps 'which languages does this project use' as a single source of truth in the repo. New team members get the right LSPs automatically when they spin up the container.
If .claude/settings.json doesn't exist yet (fresh repo), the install script is a no-op and the container still works.
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq && chmod +x ./scripts/install-enabled-lsps.sh && ./scripts/install-enabled-lsps.sh && claude --version && echo 'Claude Code ready'
